description: Confirm or decline one booking request. Two things to tell the user before calling: this is a commitment to a real person, so ask first; and QRTap sends the guest NO notification, so somebody still has to ring the phone number on the request. The status here is the business's own record of that decision. It cannot be moved back to 'new'.

status.description: The decision. A request cannot be moved back to 'new'.

name: qrtap_set_booking_status
